checks.name: safeStorage encryption is available on this Windows account
ciphertext does not contain the plaintext
round trip returns the exact value (incl. non-ASCII)
encryption is randomised (same value -> different ciphertext)
corrupted ciphertext fails loudly (so a recovery path is needed, never silent garbage)
checks.detail: threw: Error while decrypting the ciphertext provided to safeStorage.decryptString.

data.note: DPAPI binds ciphertext to this Windows user (and, for Chromium's os_crypt, to the app's Local State key). A restored backup on another PC/user cannot decrypt: the migration must keep a recovery path (re-enter the password) and must not delete the plaintext until the encrypted copy is verified.
